Peanut Butter Brownie Cheesecake
By: Angela Coleby
Published: Tuesday, May 16, 2017 - 6:34pm

Ingredients




Brownie Base
1/4 cup (38g) coconut flour
4 eggs
1/4 cup (22g) cocoa powder unsweetened
1/2 cup erythritol or sugar sweetener
1/2 cup (113g) butter softened, unsalted
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
Cheesecake Topping
1 1/2 cup (375g) peanut butter smooth
2 x 8oz cream cheese softened
1/4 cup erythritol or sugar sweetener
1 cup cream whipping/double

Preparation

1 Make the brownie base 2 Pre-heat the oven to 180C/350F degrees. 3 Beat the eggs and erythritol in a bowl until blended and light in colour. 4 Add the butter and mix until blended 5 Add the remaining ingredients and whisk until the mixture is smooth and is an even chocolate colour. 6 Place the brownie mixture into a greased, parchment line spring form cake tin (I use a 8 inch size) 7 Bake for 20-25 minutes until firm. 8 Remove from the oven and allow to cool. 9 Make the Cheesecake 10 In a bowl, beat the cream cheese and erythritol together until the cream cheese is smooth. 11 Add the peanut butter and blend until the peanut butter colour is smooth and even throughout. 12 In another bowl, whip the cream until stiff. 13 Fold the cream into the peanut butter mixture. 14 Spoon on top of the brownie base then place in the fridge for at least 5 hours or overnight to set.

About

Behold my peanut butter cheesecake with a chocolate brownie recipe.    A winning combination of both cheesecake and brownie.
